'''''Dateline Coruscant''''' was a section of [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] transmitting and depicting events from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the news was delivered by [[Rule Davenbay]], a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] ''Dateline Coruscant'' reporter.
